composition_variation: Show an original 28-year-old anime woman with a dark auburn ponytail, taking a quiet break on a gentle snowy slope. She wears a fully covering plum snowboard jacket, pale gray snow trousers, gloves, boots, and a helmet with goggles lifted above her eyes. A colorful unlettered snowboard stands beside her. Use crisp anime shading, lavender snow shadows, apricot dawn light, and a lively satisfied smile. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
